basis: Source pixel coordinates from the upper-left, manually annotated on approved 2D photographs. Rectangles are reference regions, never texture slices for direct assembly.

body.unit: % of projected crown-to-shoe-floor in the approved standing shot
body.precision: manual pixel picks, visible garment/shoe geometry only

rules: Use approved face-master for identity and suit-body-front for the standing proportions in every assembly recipe.
All components share this actor revision; never mix an unverified candidate, another character, or pixels from different perspectives into an image.
For image generation use whole reference photos; named crop boxes explain what to inspect. Use a single camera view and pose per output.
Resize the approved whole figure uniformly. Compare a new pose against that pose and matching camera angle. A cropped scene cannot establish the hidden segment dimensions.
Side and back references support visible clothing/hair/shoes. Body depth, true circumferences, skin under clothing, and occluded joints cannot be derived from this blueprint.
